1445-1913-4871-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-8227.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Loot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2390-2794-6191.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2390-2794-6191.description:
Gain life.
Trelasarra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to scry 1
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1849-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

679-6191-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
679-6191-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lich's Mastery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-2841-3875-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-3875-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Tireless Provisioner and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

654-851-1308-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

997-1417-1580-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4496-5220-6273-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Gwenom has attacked this turn.
4496-5220-6273-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

225-3678-6681-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
There's another land on the battlefield.
225-3678-6681-6879.description:
Play Strip Mine.
When Strip Mine enters, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Strip Mine.
Activate Strip Mine's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, targeting another land.
Haru triggers, returning Strip Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Strip Mine enters, Retreat to Emeria and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Strip Mine.
Repeat from step 3.
225-3678-6681-6879.notes: You can use this combo as a lock, destroying any lands you wish as they enter. To do this combo infinitely, simply target the same land each loop while keeping the Strip Mine abilities on the stack.

3883-4499-7498-7544.description:
Cast a copy of Wheel of Fortune from exile by paying {2}{R}, unpreparing Naktamun Lorespinner.
Resolve the copy of Wheel of Fortune, causing each player to discard their hand, drawing seven cards, and creating seven Treasure tokens for each opponent due to Hullbreacher.
Activate Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding mana.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying that mana, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Naktamun Lorespinner.
Repeat.

1061-4428-7393.easyPrerequisites: You control a Shard that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1061-4428-7393.description:
Activate Niko by paying {2} and tapping it, exiling Timestream Navigator and causing Shards you control to become a copy of Timestream Navigator until the end step.
Activate a Shard by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of the next end step, Timestream Navigator is returned from exile to the battlefield. Thassa then triggers, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Repeat each turn.

2104-2239-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and exiling Ephemerate.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-891-1258.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Abduction triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boonweaver Giant trigger, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

465-997-3175.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

101-4067-6281-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
101-4067-6281-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Vampire Charmseeker.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Vampire Charmseeker that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Vampire Charmseeker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

1579-2921-6972--112.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
1579-2921-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

2466-5051-5078-5243.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1062-3484-5436-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3484-5436-5674.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

4535-5641-6012.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Good-Fortune Unicorn triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Reluctant Role Model's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

245-1069-4785-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-4785-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

1020-2866-3836-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-1819-3260.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in your hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
You have a way to give Syr Konrad lifelink.
1445-1819-3260.description:
Give Syr Konrad lifelink, if needed.
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} or 2 life and discarding a creature card.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain life equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Tortured Existence ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Syr Konrad triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain life equal to the damage dealt.
Repeat.
1445-1819-3260.notes: You may do this combo without giving Syr Konrad lifelink, although you will be limited by your lifetotal and black mana available for near-infinite results and no lifegain. You will net life as long as Syr Konrad has lifelink and you have two or more opponents.

1018-1170-2196-2701.easyPrerequisites: You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1018-1170-2196-2701.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Frantic Search from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Dark Ritual, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{B}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands.
Repeat.

1429-4659-4875-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1429-4659-4875-5402.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore, adding {C}{C}.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

64-1987-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
64-1987-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Warden of the Eye and Peregrine Drake.
When Warden of the Eye and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
64-1987-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

2527-4275-4659-5489-5490.notablePrerequisites:
Zellix does not have summoning sickness.
Pith Driller does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2527-4275-4659-5489-5490.description:
Activate Zellix by paying {1} and tapping it.
Haunted One triggers, causing all Horrors you control to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Zellix ability, causing a player to mill three cards.
If the player milled a creature card this way, Zellix triggers, creating a 1/1 Horror creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Pith Driller, adding {C}{C}.
When Pith Driller dies, its undying ability and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Pith Driller trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Pith Driller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Horrors.
Repeat.

366-4050-5003-5296.description:
Activate Workhorse by removing four +1/+1 counters, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Workhorse, adding one mana of any color.
Workhorse dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Workhorse from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Workhorse enters the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it.
Purphoros triggers, dealing 2 damages to each opponent.
Repeat.
